summaryParagraphs: SpotCheck replayed your 9-month plan over 6,922 overlapping windows starting between 4 Jan 1999 and 14 Jan 2026. Because neighbouring windows share most of their days, that is closer to 35 separate histories than 6,922.
Converting everything at once costs S$19,284 at today's mid rate plus your spread. That cost is known today, so it has no range.
Waiting until the deadline ranged from S$17,865 to S$20,416 in 90% of windows, with a most expensive case of S$22,094. It cost less than converting at once in 57% of windows.
In this history, spreading over 6 conversions had a most expensive case S$1,077 lower than waiting, and a median within S$84.95 of converting at once.

A target 2.0% below the starting rate was reached before the deadline in 64% of windows; when it wasn't, the plan fell back to converting on the deadline. Its median cost was S$396 below converting at once.
These are past outcomes, not forecasts: future rates can move in ways this history never did.
